correctness.rationale: With fixed unit-edge metric, Kantorovich-Rubinstein duality identifies the global W1 operator norm with the maximum absolute row sum of the edge-gradient semigroup. Direct generator substitution gives h_dot=-2eps h-sum g_j and g_dot_i=-eps h-g_i-sum g_j. Ordinary contrasts decay e^-t, and (h,avg g) follows a 2x2 matrix with eigenvalues lambda_plus/minus as defined; its explicit exponential yields exceptional row sum A exp(-lambda_- t)-(A-1)exp(-lambda_+ t). Sign inequalities using lambda_-<=1 and Delta<=r+1 prove this row dominates all ordinary gradient rows for all t>=0; the deficit pair w/o attains it via the dual gradient potential. Its derivative has at most one sign change and is positive at zero except r=2,eps=1, proving unique peak including boundary; direct Taylor expansion with fixed r gives eps log eps corrections. I independently reconstructed full Markov Q and scipy matrix exponentials and computed the star tree W1 edge costs in 96 parameter/time cases; defect dominance and exact formula matched. The analytic proof covers all r,eps,t, beyond the finite check.
